en: Abu al-Qasim Khalaf ibn al-Abbas al-Zahrawi
ar: أبو القاسم خلف بن العباس الزهراوي

description.tr: Cerrahinin babası — 200'den fazla cerrahi alet tasarladı (çoğu bugün modifiye edilmiş biçimde hâlâ kullanılıyor) ve Avrupa doktorlarının 500 yıl güvendiği kesin cerrahi ders kitabını yazdı || Zehrâvî'nin Tasrîf'i, özellikle cerrahi üzerine 30. cildi, ilk resimli cerrahi el kitabıydı. Katarakt, litotripsi, tiroidektomi ve koterizasyon prosedürlerini anlattı ve cerrahi iğne, forseps ve ligatür dahil aletler icat etti. || [Tarih notu] Spink ve Lewis'in 1973 cerrahi cilt çevirisi, Zehrâvî'nin yeniliklerini modern tıp tarihçilerine tanıttı.
description.en: Father of surgery — designed 200+ surgical instruments (many still used in modified form today) and wrote the definitive surgical textbook that European doctors relied on for 500 years || Zahrawi's Tasrif, especially its 30th volume on surgery, was the first illustrated surgical manual. He described procedures for cataracts, lithotripsy, thyroidectomy, and cauterization, and invented instruments including the surgical needle, forceps, and ligature. The Latin translation by Gerard of Cremona (c. 1150) made it the standard surgical reference at Salerno, Montpellier, and Paris. || [Historiographical note] Spink and Lewis's 1973 translation of the surgical volume revealed Zahrawi's innovations to modern medical historians. The claim of '200+ instruments' is based on detailed illustrations in surviving manuscripts — some are elaborations of earlier designs, but many are demonstrably original.
description.ar: أبو الجراحة — صمّم أكثر من ٢٠٠ أداة جراحية وكتب الكتاب الجراحي المرجعي || التصريف أول دليل جراحي مصوّر. وصف إجراءات الساد وتفتيت الحصى واستئصال الغدة الدرقية واخترع الإبرة الجراحية والملقط والرباط
